instructions: Render only the render_payload. Never render governance_metadata into the brief body.
Lead with yesterday, today's agenda, deadlines in the next 7 days, what needs attention, and what to focus on.
Each record-bearing section is a RecordSection: render its listed records, never a bare count. When detail_available is false, state the detail_gap_reason plainly.
Preserve all review-required, stale, and low-confidence warnings carried on items.
Do not infer beyond the packet contents.
Do not make final determinations (financial, legal, claim, payment, safety, schedule, contractual).
Do not ask for raw records.
